title: Arrumo video generation adapter
description: Declares how Arrumo asks a provider for one clip: submit a JSON job, poll its status address on the same host, then download the finished clip without credentials and store it as a workspace asset. Schema 2 adds named models whose request variants are chosen by the reference images and videos supplied, and a presigned upload flow for those references. Schema 3 gives each model a label and a localized bestFor line, lets durations list the only lengths a model takes, lets an edit variant drop durations so the clip follows its reference video, and adds {lastImage} for a closing frame.

schemaVersion.description: 2 when model, models or upload is used; 3 when a model is an object with label and bestFor, or durations use allowed or are absent.

endpoint.description: HTTPS endpoint that accepts the JSON job.

credentialSetting.description: A workspace secret setting declared in the manifest.

aspectRatios.description: Arrumo's ratios to the provider's value. Ratios a provider cannot make are left out, and the host skips that provider for them.

request.description: The JSON body. String values that are exactly {prompt}, {aspectRatio} or {duration} are replaced; {duration} becomes a number. {prompt} must appear.

statusUrl.description: Pointer to the job's HTTPS status address, which must be on the endpoint's host.

video.description: Pointer to the finished clip's HTTPS address.

error.description: Optional pointer to a short failure reason shown to the creator.

model.description: Which of models to use when the caller names none: the plugin setting's value, else default.

setting.description: A string setting whose choices are all keys of models.

models.description: Each model's variants (schema 2) or a model object with label, bestFor and variants (schema 3). The top-level endpoint, aspectRatios, durations and request remain for schema 1 hosts.

upload.description: Required when a variant takes references. The host POSTs request (with {contentType}) and the credential to endpoint on the provider's host, then PUTs the file without the credential to the HTTPS address at uploadUrl, refusing redirects and sending only content-type and x-amz-* headers from headers. The address at publicUrl goes into the generation request.

variant.description: One way to call a model. The host uses the first variant whose images and videos ranges fit the references supplied; an absent range takes none.

endpoint.description: HTTPS endpoint on the same host as the top-level endpoint.

aspectRatios.description: Required unless the variant needs at least one image, whose shape the output then follows.

durations.description: Clip lengths in seconds. Required before schema 3. In schema 3 a variant may leave it out when it takes at least one reference video, whose length the clip then follows; its request must not use {duration}.

request.description: JSON body template. Besides {prompt}, {aspectRatio} and {duration}, {image} and {video} take the first uploaded reference's address, {lastImage} the second image (schema 3, a closing frame) and {images} and {videos} the list; a field whose placeholder has no value is left out.

images.description: Reference images this variant takes, at most 9. The request must use {images}, or {image} when max is 1, or {image} and {lastImage} when max is 2.

videos.description: Reference MP4 videos this variant takes, at most 3. The request must use {videos}, or {video} when max is 1.

durations.description: Clip lengths in seconds. Requests are clamped to min and max, or moved to the nearest of allowed when it is set.

allowed.description: Schema 3. The only lengths the model takes, each between min and max; default must be one of them.

localized.description: Text per app language; en is required and used when the creator's language is missing.

model.description: Schema 3. A named model, what it is best for, and its variants.

label.description: The model's name as creators know it.

bestFor.description: One line on when to choose this model, shown to creators and agents.
